# Box-bound test deny-list for the hermetic CI job (#683).
#
# The CI workflow runs the WHOLE tests/ suite MINUS these entries, in a bare
# `python:3.12` container (no tmux, no ~/.claude, fresh HOME, uid 0). Every
# entry below was EMPIRICALLY measured to fail in exactly that container
# (docker python:3.12 + jq, a fresh clone == actions/checkout). scripts/
# ci_pytest_args.py turns this file into pytest --ignore / --deselect args:
#   * a bare FILE path         -> --ignore   (errors at COLLECTION, must be
#                                             dropped before collection)
#   * a NODE-ID (contains ::)  -> --deselect (a single box-bound test inside
#                                             an otherwise-hermetic file)
#
# This is a DENY-list on purpose: new hermetic tests run automatically, and a
# newly-added box-bound test surfaces as an honest CI failure that forces its
# author to classify it here. tests/test_ci_workflow_683.py locks that every
# path below still exists (no rot).
#
# --- Files that ERROR AT COLLECTION (module-level `tmux not found`) ---
tests/test_webterm_ctrlbw_darkening.py
tests/test_webterm_stream_footer_672.py
#
# --- tmux-dependent tests (spawn a real pane / read a live session transcript) ---
tests/test_airuleset.py::TestClaudeHistoryPopupScript::test_real_execution_fails_loudly_when_capture_pane_is_blank_too
tests/test_airuleset.py::TestClaudeHistoryPopupScript::test_real_execution_falls_back_to_real_capture_pane
tests/test_airuleset.py::TestClaudeHistoryPopupScript::test_real_execution_falls_back_when_claude_history_exits_zero_but_empty
tests/test_send_verified_adoption.py::ReplyPointerAdoption::test_verifies_against_the_session_transcript_then_pops
#
# --- git/tmux session-state dependent ---
tests/test_airuleset.py::TestSessionStartFetchHook::test_unmeasurable_status_refuses_rather_than_guesses_clean
#
# --- environment-dependent (subprocess/tooling) ---
tests/test_watchdog.py::TestBurnSnapshotJob::test_failure_never_raises
#
# --- ROOT-user artifacts (container runs as uid 0: sudo / EACCES semantics differ) ---
tests/test_owner_key_provisioning.py::TestProvisionOwnerKeys::test_root_keys_piped_via_stdin_never_argv
tests/test_owner_key_provisioning.py::TestProvisionOwnerKeys::test_root_skipped_without_passwordless_sudo
tests/test_owner_key_provisioning.py::TestProvisionOwnerKeys::test_user_keys_written_and_root_probed
tests/test_count_live_workers.py::TestCorruptTolerance::test_is_dir_permission_error_is_safe_and_never_raises
tests/test_count_live_workers.py::TestNeverRaises::test_the_default_on_warn_sink_writes_to_stderr
